title.zh: 随到达条件分支的有限展开与问答恢复
title.en: Finite reached-condition branching and question recovery

claim.zh: 有限判断、分支、顺序及提前结束的程序问题精确编译为原生问题。完整翻译问答一致且接收侧有限分支时，不同原生程序的有限宏历史有同测终点的对应。原固定词精确嵌入；前段的每个端点保持判断时，提前判断保真。
claim.en: Finite guarded, sequential and choice program questions compile exactly to native questions. Complete translated-answer agreement and receiving-side finite branching match finite macro histories over different native programs, preserving endpoint answers. Fixed words embed exactly; moving a guard earlier is sound if every prefix endpoint preserves it.

hypotheses.zh: 给定有限无循环Program语法、原生过程、原子问题对应和到达位置上的guard语义。
hypotheses.en: Supplied finite loop-free Program syntax, native processes, atomic-question correspondence and guards interpreted at reached positions.

hypotheses.zh: 跨程序匹配需初始完整翻译问答一致及接收侧ImageFinite；提前判断的充分条件是全部前段结果保持该判断。
hypotheses.en: Cross-program matching requires complete initial translated-answer agreement and receiving-side ImageFinite; safe early testing requires guard preservation at all prefix endpoints.

correspondence.zh: 每个执行投到同一过程的原生路径。guard和管理步骤在语义中不另计物理事件，不独自给出传感、学习或资源实施。
correspondence.en: Every execution projects to a native path in the same process. Guards and administrative steps contribute no represented physical events and do not establish sensing, learning or resource implementation.

detail.zh: 用后继匹配恢复条件程序的边界历史。
detail.en: Use successor matching to recover guarded-program boundary histories.

input.zh: program_image_finite 供给有限端点；guarded_history_matches 逐步使用同测恢复。
input.en: program_image_finite supplies finite endpoints; guarded_history_matches uses answer recovery stepwise.

conditions.zh: 完整翻译问答一致与接收侧有限性，不推出全部中间位置对应。
conditions.en: Complete translated-answer agreement and receiving-side finiteness; no general internal-position matching.

detail.zh: word_program_exact 将固定有限词嵌入新语法；通用编译被推广，不把历史包装另计独立发现。
detail.en: word_program_exact embeds fixed finite words into the new grammar; generic compilation is extended, without recounting historical wrappers as discoveries.

limitations.zh: 不涵盖无界循环、实际判断取得、概率、部署终止或任意内部语法的中间位置互译；提前判断条件只证明充分性。
limitations.en: Does not cover unbounded loops, actual guard acquisition, probabilities, deployment termination or internal-position translation across arbitrary syntax; the early-testing condition is sufficient only.

detail.zh: 同一过程形成前后canFinish改变；提前测试与到达后测试有不同结果。
detail.en: The same process changes canFinish through formation; testing early and after arrival yields different outcomes.
